steps.en: Install with Homebrew and open the app
steps.zh: 用 Homebrew 装上并打开应用

steps.en: Sits in the menu bar, under 100 MB of RAM
steps.zh: 常驻菜单栏，内存占用不到 100 MB

steps.en: Record one global shortcut in Settings
steps.zh: 在设置里录一个全局快捷键

steps.en: Press the shortcut anywhere, type a few letters
steps.zh: 在任何应用里按下快捷键，敲几个字母

steps.en: The palette fuzzy-filters apps, commands and clipboard history
steps.zh: 面板对应用、命令和剪贴板历史做模糊过滤

steps.en: Launches it — an app, quicklink, snippet or a Raycast extension
steps.zh: 启动它——应用、快捷链接、片段或 Raycast 扩展

value.en: Everything you reach for all day answers to one hotkey — no Dock hunting, no per-app menus, no separate clipboard app
value.zh: 全天要用的东西都归一个快捷键管——不用翻 Dock、不用记各应用的菜单、也不用再装一个剪贴板工具

sources: https://github.com/abue-ammar/tinycast README — Using it (Settings → General; ↵ to launch)
